summary: Frontend 'After every production run' feature tested end-to-end. All 5 scenarios pass. Temp ZZ equipment/staff/batches/post_run_tasks/maintenance_records cleaned up.

test_results.T1_equipment_master_post_run_switch_and_: PASS - /equipment-master row eq-row-ZZ-Post-UI → open dropdown eq-more-actions-ZZ-Post-UI → eq-edit-ZZ-Post-UI. Maintenance Schedule auto-expanded (post block visible). eq-post-run-switch toggled off→on (data-state=checked), Save → row shows eq-post-run-badge-<id> 'After every production run'. Reopen → switch persists data-state=checked.
test_results.T2_create_batch_gate_and_block: PASS - Create Batch (SKU vgdemo-sku, no pending initially, gate absent) → ZZ-POST-UI1 created (toast 'Batch created successfully'). Reopen Create Batch same SKU → pre-production-gate visible, pre-production-gate-title='Production checklist: 1 of 1 pending', item shows 'AFTER RUN ZZ Post UI · after batch ZZ-POST-UI1 — pending'. Submit → blocked toast 'Pre-production checklist pending: ZZ Post UI'.
test_results.T3_pre_production_scan_post_section_tick: PASS - Fresh /pre-production-scan/nyla-air-water context; staff PIN login (staff-use-pin-btn → staff-pick-<staffId> → PIN 8888 → staff-pin-submit). pre-production-section-post 'After production run' present with row 'ZZ Post UI · Pending · After batch ZZ-POST-UI1 · Demo 500ml'. Tick pre-production-check-<taskId> → 'Done' + toast 'ZZ Post UI — after-run maintenance recorded (batch ZZ-POST-UI1)'. Untick → 'Pending' + toast 'record removed'. Retick → 'Done'.
test_results.T4_batch_created_with_clearance_and_new_: PASS - Reopen Create Batch (same SKU) → pre-production-gate-title='Production checklist complete (1)', item shows 'AFTER RUN ZZ Post UI · after batch ZZ-POST-UI1 — cleared by ZZ Post Staff UI · <ts>'. ZZ-POST-UI2 created; batch detail badge batch-detail-pre-production-clearances='Pre-production ✓ 1'. Revisit /pre-production-scan → NEW pending task listed 'After batch ZZ-POST-UI2 · Demo 500ml · Pending'.
test_results.T5_equipment_scan_post_run_done: PASS - /equipment-scan/<eqId> as staff shows card eqscan-post-run-<taskId> 'After production run — batch ZZ-POST-UI2 · Demo 500ml · run started …' with button eqscan-post-run-done-<taskId>. Click → 'Done by ZZ Post Staff UI · <ts>' + toast 'After-run maintenance recorded for batch ZZ-POST-UI2'.

critical_code_review_comments: PreProductionScan.js progress badge only counts state.items (before-run) — post_items are excluded even though they appear in the same list. Consider updating pre-production-progress to '{cleared}/{items+post_items}' for consistency with the gate title.
EquipmentMaster.js still exceeds 1500 lines; splitting AssignStaffDialog, LogDialog and the equipment form dialog into subcomponents would help maintainability.
